You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, os,re, itertools, math
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps4(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==2 and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==2 and (x,y) not in seen: st.append((x,y))
                out.append(comp)
    return out
# Build big table of per-block features + label, then check pairwise-feature-disjointness between kept & changed classes
rows=[]
for p in range(1,6):
    di=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); do=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    pts=[(float(min(a for a,_ in cl)),float(min(b for _,b in cl))) for cl in comps4(di.tolist())]
    n=len(pts)
    lab=[]
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
        cl=[cl_ for cl_ in comps4(di.tolist()) if (min(a for a,_ in cl_),min(b for _,b in cl_))==(r,c)][0]
        lab.append(int(any(do[a][b]==8 for a,b in cl)))
    H,W=di.shape
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
        cy,cx=H/2,W/2
        dr,dc=r-cy,c-cx
        feat=dict(p=p,r=r,c=c,y=lab[i],
            u=r+c,v=c-r,
            dr=dr,dc=dc,
            dd=max(abs(dr),abs(dc)), eu=(dr*dr+dc*dc)**.5,

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps4(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==2 and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==2 and (x,y) not in seen: st.append((x,y))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

    di=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); do=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])

def blocks_of(di):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])

                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

import numpy as np,pandas as pd,itertools,os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==2 and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==2 and (x,y) not in seen: st.append((x,y))
                out.append(comp)
    return out
data=[]
for p in range(1,6):
    di=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); do=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])

    for bl in Cl:
        q=(min(a for a,_ in bl), min(b for _,b in bl))

        data.append(dict(p=p,r=r0,c=c0,y=lab,bl=bl))

    res={}
    res['rowuniq'] = len({q for q in blockset if q[0]==b[0]})==1
    res['coluniq'] = len({q for q in blockset if q[1]==b[1]})==1
    # visible partners (same row/col/diag, nothing between)
    vis=[]
    for o in blockset:

        dr,dc=b[0]-o[0],b[1]-o[1]
        g=__gcd=abs(np.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)))
        if g!=0 and (dr//g,dc//g) in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
            vis.append(o)
    res['visdeg']=len(vis)

    res['visge2']=res['visdeg']>=2
    # chebyshev neighbors
